q1_issues.issue: (Degree sk_attacks_1 simultaneous almost) applies the Degree construction to 'almost', an approximative that does not entail the positive property, whereas the instruction set defines Degree for entailing intensifiers/downtoners and requires the positive atom to be asserted alongside it.

q2_gaps: approximative degree modifier 'almost' + adjective - non-entailing, so neither the Degree pattern nor a plain property atom fits

numeric compound modifier naming a collective's size - '14-member cell' - has no stated encoding; Cardinality is defined as riding on a GroupOf group, while 'the cell' here is a collective-noun individual
notes: Seal structure is right throughout: 'said' and the impersonal 'believed to have carried out' both seal under Theme (the latter with no Experiencer), definites project only their typing atoms to top level, and the past perfect correctly gets no Before because ordering never crosses a seal boundary. Location and Time are attached to the group symbol sk_attacks_1 rather than to an eventuality, which extends the event-noun rule to a group of event nouns.
